text: シルフ　スコープなる　マシンなら　ゆうれい　ポケモンの　しょうたいを　みやぶる　というが…

structure.jp: シルフ　スコープなる　マシンなら
structure.en: if it's the machine called the Silph Scope

structure.jp: ゆうれい　ポケモンの　しょうたいを　みやぶる
structure.en: it sees through the true identity of ghost Pokémon

patterns.name: 〜なる (called)
patterns.span: シルフ　スコープなる　マシン
patterns.explanation: なる between a name and a noun is an old-fashioned way to say 'called', used for something you only know by name. シルフ スコープなる マシン = 'a machine called the Silph Scope'.

patterns.name: 〜という
patterns.explanation: という after a full statement means 'they say that', passing on something heard. みやぶる という = 'they say it sees through'.

patterns.name: 〜なら
patterns.explanation: なら after a noun means 'if it is that one', picking it out as the thing that can do it. マシンなら = 'with that machine, at least'.
